content.text: Recurrence: after the initial content fix, two macros in the EU language pack still expanded the 2025 refund clause when agents selected the localized refund template; purged the stale translations and added a CI check that fails if policy macros reference the retired year.
Support macros still insert refund policy text dated 2025 that legal retired after the policy refresh.
Agents using the macros send outdated refund windows and eligibility language to customers on the portal.
Update macro content to the current policy, add a review date field so stale macros surface in admin, and notify teams that reused the old text.
